issue.title: Enable reloading of synonym_graph filters

labels.name: :Search Relevance/Analysis
labels.description: How text is split into tokens

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Reloading of `synonym_graph` filter doesn't work currently because the search time
AnalysisMode doesn't get propagated to the TokenFilterFactory emitted by the
graph filters getChainAwareTokenFilterFactory() method. This change fixes that.

Closes #45127

body: Thanks @kasa-taku for reporting this and the great reproduction. I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/45135 to fix this.
